scope: Seven requested extension directions; bounded implementation and actual acceptance are recorded separately.

items.acceptance: Real gravity, rails and circle contacts; original clips preserved; native editable output roundtrip; no per-frame pose snapping.

deliverables: Shared-camera pixel comparison and explicit masks
items.acceptance: Unchanged output passes; deliberate drift fails; camera/resource/baseline drift is reported.

deliverables: Build compatibility and incremental-edit feasibility report
items.acceptance: No injected input or focus activation; model/undo unchanged by view controls. Unsupported builds and incremental undo operations remain explicit rather than emulated.

deliverables: Explicit arbitrary multi-bone chain contact baking
items.acceptance: Non-humanoid chains supported by explicit landmarks; unreachable targets rejected; original source bytes preserved; unsupported PSD semantics reported.

deliverables: Prop/hand contact handoff on explicit bone branches
items.acceptance: New editable clip; source clips and references preserved; contact error and transition diagnostics returned.

deliverables: Strict Spine4.2 subset exporter with official JS runtime validation
items.acceptance: No version-label-only conversion; unrepresentable data rejects; real target-runtime playback and sampled pose comparisons.

deliverables: Linux GPU/container diagnosis and release evidence
items.acceptance: Hardware modes pass only with real receipts. Missing physical GPUs/macOS/24h elapsed time cannot be marked passed. A terminated continuous-soak process requires a NEW run; interrupted fragments are never added into a 24h pass.

sourceProtection: All authoring outputs are NEW; plans pin source/resource hashes. Remote database and Redis access remains read-only.
